from rcb_traj import Session
import numpy as np
s=Session('hanging_mug',instance='/app/instance.json')
env=s.env
from envs.utils import ArmTag
s.record_start()
env.move(env.grasp_actor(env.mug,ArmTag('left'),pre_grasp_dis=.10,grasp_dis=0))
rack_mid=(env.rack.get_pose().p+np.asarray(env.rack.get_functional_point(0)[:3]))/2
target=[float(rack_mid[0]),float(rack_mid[1]),float(rack_mid[2]+.055),1.,0.,0.,0.]
env.move(env.place_actor(env.mug,ArmTag('left'),target,functional_point_id=0,constrain='auto',pre_dis=.10,dis=.01,is_open=False))
# Predicate explicitly requires the right gripper to be open.
env.move(env.open_gripper(ArmTag('right')))
print('plan',env.plan_success,'goal fp',env.mug.get_functional_point(0)[:3], 'rack midpoint',rack_mid,'status',s.status())
actions=s.record_stop()
print('replay',s.replay(actions))
if not s.status()['success']:
    raise RuntimeError('replay did not succeed')
s.save_trajectory(actions,'/app/output/trajectory.npz',meta={'method':'left places mug functional point at rack midpoint height; right gripper open'})
